#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare probe predictions with both PN-only and all-detector GTI weights."""
import csv
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
base, variant = map(lambda x: Path(x).resolve(), sys.argv[1:3])
a = np.genfromtxt(base/"probe.csv", delimiter=",", names=True)
b = np.genfromtxt(variant/"probe.csv", delimiter=",", names=True)
with (ROOT/"observations/xmm_gtis.tsv").open() as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f, delimiter="\t"))
groups = {"PN_only": [r for r in rows if r["detector"].lower() == "pn"],
          "all_detector_exposure": rows}


def comet_velocity(day):
    ephemeris = np.genfromtxt(ROOT/"observations/ephemeris_comet.tsv", delimiter="\t", names=True)
    basis = np.array(json.loads((ROOT/"observations/coordinate_system.json").read_text())["ecliptic_to_solar_equatorial_matrix"])
    xyz = np.array([np.interp(day+60980, ephemeris["mjd_utc"], ephemeris[k]) for k in ["x_au", "y_au", "z_au"]]).T@basis.T
    vel = np.array([np.interp(day+60980, ephemeris["mjd_utc"], ephemeris[k]) for k in ["vx_au_day", "vy_au_day", "vz_au_day"]]).T@basis.T*149597870.7/86400
    radius = np.linalg.norm(xyz, axis=1)
    theta, phi = np.arccos(xyz[:,2]/radius), np.arctan2(xyz[:,1],xyz[:,0])
    er = xyz/radius[:,None]
    et = np.array([np.cos(theta)*np.cos(phi), np.cos(theta)*np.sin(phi), -np.sin(theta)]).T
    ep = np.array([-np.sin(phi), np.cos(phi), np.zeros_like(phi)]).T
    return np.array([np.sum(vel*e,axis=1) for e in [er,et,ep]]).T


def weighted_mean(t, values, intervals):
    total, duration = 0., 0.
    for start, stop in intervals:
        knots = np.r_[start, t[(t > start) & (t < stop)], stop]
        total += np.trapezoid(np.interp(knots, t, values), knots)
        duration += stop-start
    return total/duration


result = {"baseline": str(base), "variant": str(variant),
          "baseline_statistics": json.loads((base/"statistics.json").read_text()),
          "variant_statistics": json.loads((variant/"statistics.json").read_text()),
          "GTI_comparisons": {}}
for group, gtis in groups.items():
    intervals = [(float(z["start_mjd_utc"])-60980, float(z["stop_mjd_utc"])-60980) for z in gtis]
    lo, hi = min(g[0] for g in intervals), max(g[1] for g in intervals)
    probes = {}
    for pid, name in [(0, "comet"), (1, "earth"), (2, "stereo"), (3, "solar_orbiter")]:
        aa, bb = a[a["probe_id"] == pid], b[b["probe_id"] == pid]
        if not len(aa):
            continue
        assert np.max(abs(aa["day"]-bb["day"])) < 1e-10
        fields = {}
        va = {field: aa[field] for field in ["n_cm3", "speed_kms", "flux_cm2_s", "Br_nt"]}
        vb = {field: bb[field] for field in va}
        if pid == 0:
            vc = comet_velocity(aa["day"])
            for sample, values in [(aa,va),(bb,vb)]:
                wind = np.column_stack([sample[k] for k in ["vr_kms", "vtheta_kms", "vphi_kms"]])
                values["relative_speed_kms"] = np.linalg.norm(wind-vc, axis=1)
                values["incident_flux_cm2_s"] = sample["n_cm3"]*values["relative_speed_kms"]*1e5
        for field in va:
            denominator = np.maximum(abs(va[field]), max(np.mean(abs(va[field]))*.01,1e-30))
            span = (aa["day"] >= lo) & (aa["day"] <= hi)
            ma, mb = weighted_mean(aa["day"], va[field], intervals), weighted_mean(bb["day"], vb[field], intervals)
            fields[field] = dict(baseline_GTI_mean=float(ma), alternate_GTI_mean=float(mb),
                                 GTI_mean_relative_change=float(mb/ma-1) if abs(ma)>1e-30 else None,
                                 maximum_abs_relative_change_within_observation_span=float(np.max(abs(vb[field][span]-va[field][span])/denominator[span])))
        probes[name] = fields
    result["GTI_comparisons"][group] = dict(first_day=lo, last_day=hi, interval_count=len(intervals),
                                            total_detector_exposure_seconds=sum(b-a for a,b in intervals)*86400,
                                            probes=probes)
dest = Path(sys.argv[3]).resolve() if len(sys.argv)>3 else ROOT/"solver/diagnostics"/f"{variant.name}_vs_{base.name}_comparison.json"
dest.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+"\n")
print("Saved:", dest)
print("PN-only comet comparison:")
print(json.dumps(result["GTI_comparisons"]["PN_only"]["probes"]["comet"], indent=2))
